book.name: Malaka
book.title: MALAKA Pâri ara ŋana Yesu Kirisi kâ Malaka iŋgere

content: Yesu ilâ Jerusalem lawea itogo koipu ŋalae
Kinzi silâ sipâŋga Jerusalem lawea tini laiti, aku sipâŋga Betfasi lawea wa Betani lawea wa, lâ Oliv Tuu waŋgira. Aku Yesu isupwanzi ne pâri-tamâta rua,

ku ipainzi tu, “Miki rua kalâ pa lawea ndai ikeno naomi ŋinde, aku kalâ lawea ŋinde ilo. Aku walele nâ miki ma kamora ‘donki’ natu toŋge kinzi sisine lâ imandi. Tamâta toŋge muŋga isaŋona donki ŋinde kumbu, ande tia. Kayaute wâlo piti, ku kakai kamâ.
Ambo tamâta toŋge ma ikasoŋami tu, ‘Ŋana sâ kâ ŋga miki rua kaveta mine, a?’, ande miki ma kapai tu, ‘Maro Ŋalae ne wurâta nde ikeno papa, aku mwaŋga i ma walele nâ io taulo imâ kilo’.”
Ŋineŋga kinzi rua silâ, aku simora donki natu kinzi muŋga sisine imandi nia yo lâ luma toŋge ne nzâla tini. Aku kinzi rua siyaute wâlo piti lâ donki tini.
Andeta tamâta pinde simandi laiti, aku sikasoŋanzi tu, “Ayo, miki rua kaveta mana ŋga kayaute donki natu ŋinde, a?”
Aku kinzi siporo ŋgua taulo panzi ikura Yesu muŋga itula panzi mine, aku kinzi tamâta ŋinde sisâu panzi rua tu sikai donki silâ.
Ŋineŋga kinzi sikai donki natu ŋinde simâ pa Yesu. Aku siliŋi nenzi pasawaŋa luandondo kâki donki kumbu, ku Yesu isaŋona kulu.
Aŋga kinzi tamâta rârâ nde siŋga nenzi pasawaŋa luandondo lâ nzâla. Aŋga pinde nde silâ tâno ilo ku sitoto tumba lau ku sikai simâ silalaga lâ nzâla tava, ŋana Yesu ma iyoka kulu kâ.
Aku kinzi tamâta pinde nde silâ simuŋga panzi, aŋga pinde nde soka i muli, ande rârâni sindeka sisarâwa tu, “Paneâŋa pa âta! Maro Kindeni itu nzâmbe pa koipu ŋalae ŋine ikai i ndamwa kala imâ!
Mao nâ, Maro Kindeni itu nzâmbe pa tamâta ŋine kala imâ ikai koipu itogo timbunda Daviti mine! Tapanea Maro Kindeni i âta Tamwata!”

Kinzi soka mine lee sipâŋga Jerusalem lawea, aku Yesu ilâ Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ilo ku mata imora ilâ wa imâ wa, ku imora kelekele rârâni keno luma sapâŋa ilo. Andeta kari ŋga indue pararai lâ. Mine kala Yesu itaulo ilâ pa Betani lawea kunzi ne pâri-tamâta saŋao kanaŋonzi rua.
Yesu iporo itu kaika papa kâi toŋge, kala ŋgâla-ŋgâla lâ
Aku mbwale kilo, ŋineŋga kinzi simandi sipile Betani lawea ku soka sitaulo silâ pa Jerusalem kilo, andeta Yesu nde putole ipu.

I mata ilâ imora kâi ‘fik’ toŋge imandi malawae mwasa, aku lau ŋani-ŋani ŋalae ŋinde, kala ilâ laiti tu iroto kanaŋo. Aku ilâ papa kâi, andeta imora tu kanaŋo toŋge keno tia; lau nâ ikeno, ŋana tu zo ŋana ‘fik’ tu ipula kanaŋo kâ nde ipâŋga tia yo.
Tia ku Yesu iporo pa kâi ŋinde mine tu, “Noko ma kupula kanaŋo kilo tia ndo!” Aku kinzi pâri-tamâta siloŋo ne ŋgua ŋinde.
Yesu iŋaranzi mbaliŋa warakanzi lâ Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa

Kinzi silâ lee sipâŋga Jerusalem lawea. Aku Yesu ilâ pa Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ku iŋaranzi mbaliŋa warakanzi simo sipako kelekele lâ nia ŋinde. Itili peke lâ kinzi tamâta ŋana sipalulua mbumbu kâ, aŋga itili paŋgi lâ kinzi tamâta siveta wurâta ŋana sipako sii ŋana patarawâŋa kâ tava.
Ŋineŋga indi kaika panzi tu ma sikai kelekele kie-kie simâ luma sapâŋa ne ŋgumbi ilo ndimo.
Aku ipainzi tu, “Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua ikeno mine tu,

content.text: “‘Naneŋgu luma nde ma kinzi sipatu ŋa tu, “Kinzi ŋgu ndoni nenzi luma ŋana noŋa kâ’”,

content: aŋga miki nde kaveta ŋine ipâŋga itogo kinzi nzanzare tamâta nenzi munâŋa nia mine!”

Aku kinzi patarawâŋa tamâta ŋalaŋala ŋga kinzi pananâŋa tamâta ŋana ŋgua tukuŋa kâ nde siloŋo ŋgua ŋinde, kala siroto nzâla ŋana ma sipu i pâta imâte kâ. Andeta kinzi siruru ŋana i kâ, ŋana tu kinzi tamâta rârâni nde wisinzi motutu ŋana i kawa ŋgua.
Aku kari indue lala lâ, ŋineŋga Yesu ikainzi ne pâri-tamâta sipile Jerusalem lawea ku siyâti silâ.
Ambo tamâta toŋge kalo tawana mao ku ikai noŋa, ande Maro Kindeni ma ipaloŋo papa i
Aku wurita mboyo, ŋineŋga kinzi soka silâ, aku simora kâi ‘fik’ ŋinde tu lau tava mburu-mburu ndoni nde ŋgâla-ŋgâla marumbu lâ.
Ŋineŋga Petero kalo ŋgere ku iporo tu, “Pananâŋa, kumora ŋga! Nola noko kutu ŋgua kaika pa kâi ŋine, kala ŋgâla-ŋgâla lâ!”
Aku Yesu iporo taulo panzi tu, “Miki kao nemi kalo-tawana ilâ pa Maro Kindeni nâ.

Naŋa aporo mao nâ pami, ambo tamâta toŋge kalo tawana sondo, ku isupwa tuu ŋai mine tu, ‘Noko kumandi kupatiki kundue tâi ilo’, ambo tamâta ŋinde ilo rua-rua tia, i kalo tawana nâ kala iporo, ande Maro Kindeni ma iveta mâsi ŋinde ipâŋga, ikura tamâta ŋinde iporo mine.
Ambo miki kano pa Maro Kindeni, aku kalomi tawana ku kaporo lâ ilomi tu, ‘Mao nâ, i ma iveta ikura naneŋgu noŋa mine’, ande mao nâ, i ma iveta mine.

Andeta miki kaloŋo ŋga; lâ zo ŋana miki kano pa Maro Kindeni, ambo miki kalomi ŋgere ŋana vetâŋa soki toŋge tamâta toŋge muŋga iveta pami, ambo miki ma kazavaru tamâta ŋinde ne soki piti lâ tini, ande miki Tamami imo samba ilo kala ma iveta mine nâ pa miki. [
Taitu mambo miki kazavaru tamâta ŋinde ne soki piti lâ tini tia, ande Tamami imo samba ilo kala ma izavaru nemi kiesaka piti lâ tinimi tia mine nâ.”]
Kinzi sikasoŋa Yesu tu ikai ea ndamwa

Kinzi soka silâ sipâŋga Jerusalem lawea kilo, aku Yesu ilâ Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ne ŋgumbi ilo. Ŋineŋga kinzi patarawâŋa tamâta ŋalaŋala wa kinzi pananâŋa tamâta ŋana ŋgua tukuŋa kâ wa kinzi katonâŋa, ande simâ papa i.
Aku sikasoŋa tu, “Wa, noko pwai ea ndamwa kala kuveta mâsi kie-kie mine, a? Aŋga ea wurâta ŋine ilano, a?”
Andeta Yesu ipainzi tu, “Ara, naŋa kala atu akasoŋami kasoŋâŋa toŋge. Ambo miki ma kaporo ŋgua sondo itaulo imâ, ande naŋa ma aporo pwataki pami ŋana akai ea ndamwa ŋga aveta vetâŋa ŋine.”

Ŋineŋga ikasoŋanzi tu, “Muŋga, lâ zo ŋinde Yoane Lââ-Liliŋa Tamwata iveta wurâta ŋana ililinzi tamâta, ande ea wurâta ŋinde ilua i. Miki ilomi tu Maro Kindeni wurâta ŋinde ilua i, tiya?, i tamwata nâ ilo patea tu ma iveta. Miki kaporo imâ pa naŋa ŋga!”

Andeta kinzi siporo ŋgua lâ warakanzi ŋgininzi tu, “Ambo kinda ma taporo taulo tu, ‘Maro Kindeni isupwa Yoane tu iveta wurâta ŋinde’, ande i ma iporo pa kinda tu, ‘Mine kala ŋana sâ kâ ŋga miki ŋandai kalomi tawana Yoane ne ŋgua, a?’

Ambo kinda ma taporo taulo tu, ‘Yoane tamwata nâ ilo patea tu ma iveta wurâta ŋinde’, ande kinzi tamâta ma wisinzi nâna ŋalae pa kinda.” (Kinzi siruru ŋananzi tamâta, ŋana tu kinzi rârâni situ Yoane nde Maro Kindeni ne ŋgua-tulâŋa tamâta mao.)
Tia ku kinzi siporo ŋgua taulo pa Yesu tu, “Maka kasama tia.” Ŋineŋga Yesu ipainzi tu, “Ara, naŋa kala ma aporo ŋgua toŋge pami tia ŋana akai ea ndamwa amâ kala aveta vetâŋa ŋine.”

footnotes.text: 26 Nia ndoyo, ŋgua ŋine kala ikeno ŋgumbi ilo [], ande ikeno lâ pepa tini tia. Mine kala kinzi ilo-kalo tamâta situ tamâta toŋge ipâŋga lâ muli nde iseŋge ŋgua ŋine ilâ kuku ŋgua ikeno muŋga.
